scope: Gateway first-run boundary: real pinned CLI housekeeping and recorded downstream skill dispatch. Downstream skills are fixture stubs, not full onboard/prep/map/beep-boop executions.
offer: No faff config found. Set up faff for this repo now? (y/n)
normalisations: Per-case comparisons allow independent cases to be interleaved.
The optional --json output flag does not alter housekeeping effects; raw argv remains recorded.
The faff: namespace prefix resolves to the same bundled skill; raw names remain recorded.
Fixture workspace paths are replaced with <workspace> in file content and CLI output comparisons.
Additional config path reads are retained in the trace and reported, but do not constitute an extra mutation or dispatch. A successful initial path read must precede effectful decisions.
acceptance: No forbidden attempts, errors, missing operations, reordered mutations, incorrect offers/dispatches or final-state differences. Compare both arms against this oracle and each other. Provider usage is unmetered.
